gen-gf-gugi-gf-liter: Tall, bold, cut open. Gugi's lowercase nearly climbs to its capitals, and Liter follows in a plain sans with no stroke contrast at all and wide mouths on its round forms.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mada: Mada keeps its curves open and its midzone towering. Gugi draws every line at a single thickness for display punch, while Mada's body text gets its approachable, modern feel from that open construction.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans rides a high mean line with generously opened curves. Its size can stay modest, since the sans is built to be read, while Gugi's glowing neon-tube lettering holds a single line thickness.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-matangi: Contemporary and slightly hefty, Gugi's tall lowercase nearly meets its capitals, with terminals cut open. Matangi then settles beneath in a plain sans whose twine-like strokes keep its rounded letters open and the page grounded.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-maven-pro: Gugi's open-cut terminals let its counters flow outward, giving the heading a distinctive, bold look. And Maven Pro handles the reading, with a welcoming gap in the c and a gentle, monotone line in a high-waisted lowercase.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-michroma: Contemporary lettering leads here, with Gugi's tall lowercase nearly touching its capitals. And Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, so its plain sans curves leave daylight like a rope's open bight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-miriam-libre: Bold up top, sturdy below. Gugi does its best work with open-cut terminals and tall lowercase, while Miriam Libre's sans-serif body holds a wire-like weight and an s with generous openings.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Gugi brings tall lowercase and open-cut terminals up top. Beneath it, Mochiy Pop One's very large lowercase eye and laser-cut single stroke width make the contrast between them the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Loud on top, spacious beneath. Gugi earns its keep big and short, with tall lowercase nearly reaching its capitals, while Mochiy Pop P One lays a wide stretch of blank space between its letters.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-montserrat-underline: Sharp and chunky, then wide open. Montserrat Underline brings a plain sans with breathing counters and oversized lowercase to Gugi's tall, cut-terminal heading, and the strongest quality is how loudly their lowercase letters differ.
